info.title: INTEGIN Client API
info.description: Versioned contract for the INTEGIN loopback client surface. Go/PostgreSQL remains authoritative for tenant, organization, capability, device, workflow, and RLS decisions. Outcomes never grant authority based only on client input or OIDC claims.

post.description: The server validates device trust, authority package, signature, sequencing, tenant context, and workflow rules. A 200 response can carry an application-level rejected or held outcome; clients must inspect `outcome` and must not assume success solely from HTTP status.
The request supplies encrypted bytes and integrity metadata. INTEGIN validates tenant-scoped object handling; plaintext evidence must not be logged or placed in telemetry.

post.summary: Bind a stored encrypted evidence object to a canonical inspection
post.description: Optional pilot route. The server derives actor, tenant, organization, role, and capability from validated OIDC identity and local membership. The request must not contain tenant, organization, actor, or object-key fields. The server re-reads the contained object and verifies content type, byte count, and ciphertext digest before immutable metadata registration.
post.x-integin-enabled-when: INTEGIN_OIDC_ENABLED=true, INTEGIN_DB_URL, and an evidence store are configured in the isolated pilot

200.description: APPLIED for a new immutable record or DUPLICATE for an identical replay.

404.description: OIDC, database identity, or evidence storage composition is disabled and the optional route is not mounted.

409.description: The evidence object is missing or differs from its submitted immutable metadata, or the evidence ID conflicts with an earlier record.

post.summary: Provision a device through the local integration bridge
post.description: Available only when local provisioning is explicitly enabled for local integration. This endpoint is not a production enrollment mechanism and must be disabled in production-like deployment.

404.description: Local provisioning is disabled and the route is not mounted

get.summary: Return local tenant and organization context for an authenticated OIDC subject
get.description: Pilot-only optional route. Keycloak validates identity; the local PostgreSQL resolver determines membership and `identity.session.read` capability. No token, claims, or capabilities are exposed in the response.
get.x-integin-enabled-when: INTEGIN_OIDC_ENABLED=true in the isolated pilot only

404.description: OIDC is disabled and the optional route is not mounted

post.summary: Retrieve a signed approved work-package manifest
post.description: Pilot-only field delivery endpoint. It requires a short-lived Ed25519 device proof, is disabled unless isolated-pilot composition explicitly enables it, and does not activate package enforcement.

proof.description: Signed device proof; clients must never include tenant or organization authority claims.

404.description: No current approved assignment is available.

409.description: Device proof request identifier was replayed.

post.summary: Execute an authenticated server-authoritative certificate lifecycle action.

get.summary: Read the bounded public certificate projection by verification token.

post.description: Submits a server-authoritative partial completion for an authenticated local work-order membership.

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-ID
CorrelationId.description: Optional caller correlation value. INTEGIN supplies a safe generated identifier when absent or unsuitable for structured logs.

bearerAuth.description: Accepted only by the optional pilot OIDC route while that route is mounted.

ServiceUnavailable.description: A required runtime dependency is unavailable

AuthorizationUnavailable.description: The local identity resolver is unavailable

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 digest of canonical payload bytes.
